filer_name.rationale: PersonNm maps to the name of the HSA account holder shown at the top of Form 8889.

filer_ssn.rationale: RecipientSSN maps to the Social Security Number of the HSA account holder shown at the top of Form 8889.

tax_year.rationale: The tax year is an attribute of the IRS8889 root element or the filing metadata, not a discrete leaf element in the canonical schema.

hsa_coverage_type.rationale: Blueprint bundles both checkbox states into a single category field, but the canonical schema splits them into two separate Boolean indicators (HDHPSelfOnlyCoverageInd [5] and HDHPFamilyCoverageInd [4]); blueprint should be split into two Boolean fields.

hsa_contribution_limit.rationale: HSAFamilyDeductibleAmt is the closest match for the annual contribution limit; however, there is no self-only equivalent, and the canonical schema may represent this differently — medium confidence due to ambiguity.

additional_contribution_55_plus.rationale: HSAAddnlContributionAmt corresponds to the additional $1,000 catch-up contribution for taxpayers age 55 or older (Part I, Line 3/7).

archer_msa_contributions.rationale: TotalArcherMSAContributionAmt corresponds to Part I, Line 4 — Archer MSA contributions that reduce the HSA contribution limit.

qualified_hsa_funding_distributions.rationale: HSAQualifiedFundingDistriAmt corresponds to the qualified HSA funding distribution from an IRA (Part I, Line 5/10).

months_in_qualifying_coverage.rationale: No canonical element for the number of months of qualifying HDHP coverage exists in the provided candidate list; this line is not represented as a discrete element.

employer_contributions.rationale: HSAEmployerContributionAmt corresponds to Part I, Line 9 — employer contributions including cafeteria plan amounts from W-2 Box 12 Code W.

net_deductible_contribution_limit.rationale: HSALimitedContributionAmt is the best available match for the reduced/net deductible contribution limit line, though the naming is ambiguous relative to other HSALimited* elements.

taxpayer_contributions.rationale: HSAContributionAmt corresponds to taxpayer (non-employer) contributions actually made to the HSA for the tax year.

hsa_deduction.rationale: TotalHSADeductionAmt corresponds to Part I, Line 13 — the deductible HSA contribution flowing to Schedule 1.

total_distributions.rationale: TotalHSADistributionAmt corresponds to Part II, Line 14a — total distributions from all HSAs as reported on Form 1099-SA.

rollover_distributions.rationale: HSADistributionRolloverAmt corresponds to Part II, Line 14b — rollovers and returned mistaken distributions.

qualified_medical_expenses.rationale: UnreimbQualMedAndDentalExpAmt corresponds to Part II, Line 15 — qualified medical expenses paid using HSA distributions.

taxable_distributions.rationale: TaxableHSADistributionAmt corresponds to Part II, Line 17a — distributions not used for qualified expenses included in gross income.

distributions_after_death_disability_med.rationale: HSANetDistributionAmt is the best candidate for taxable distributions exempt from the 20% additional tax due to death/disability/age-65/Medicare exceptions.

additional_tax_on_non_qualified.rationale: HSADistriAddnlPercentTaxAmt corresponds to the 20% additional tax on non-qualified HSA distributions (Part II, Line 17c/22).

income_from_testing_period_failure.rationale: HDHPCoverageIncomeAmt corresponds to Part III — income includible due to failure to maintain HDHP coverage through the testing period.

additional_tax_testing_period_failure.rationale: HDHPCoverageAddnlTaxAmt corresponds to Part III — the additional 10% tax on testing-period failure income.

excess_contributions.rationale: No canonical element for total excess HSA contributions subject to the 6% excise tax is present in the provided candidate list.

excise_tax_on_excess_contributions.rationale: No canonical element for the 6% excise tax on excess contributions is present in the provided candidate list.
